Viewing `/api/css/billboard` under `vpr docs:dev` with the theme set to `canvas`, the live `@example`
preview's `.instui-billboard.-clickable` shows the base rule and, on hover, the border color resolves
to **text** instead of **link**. The theme-conditional override that should repoint it
(`border-color: var(--instui-component-link-text-color)`) never applies.

This is **not** staleness or caching — it's a loading gap that's present even on a clean `docs:dev`.

### Root cause

The docs switch themes at runtime by toggling `<html data-pantoken-theme="…">`. Two things must
respond to that toggle for the billboard hover to work:

1. **Token values** re-theme via `theme/generated/site-themes.css` (`:root[data-pantoken-theme="…"]`
   scoped). This works.
2. **Component rules** that change *which token* a property references (billboard's `-clickable:hover`
   border-color: `--instui-color-text-base` → `--instui-component-link-text-color`) must be re-emitted
   attribute-scoped, because `@pantoken/components/components.css` is lowered to a single theme
   (rebrand) at build time — the `themeCustomMedia` plugin prunes the `@media (--theme-canvas)` branches.

The attribute-scoped recovery already exists: `scopedComponentsCss()`
([docs/scripts/lib/scope-components.ts](docs/scripts/lib/scope-components.ts)) diffs the rebrand vs
canvas aggregates and re-emits the canvas/canvasHighContrast deltas under
`:root[data-pantoken-theme="…"]`. [demos.ts:52](docs/scripts/demos.ts) writes that sheet to
`public/demos-assets/components.css`, and I confirmed the billboard override is present there.

**The gap:** that scoped sheet is only wired into the `/play` **iframe** demos (via `cssUrls` in
[config.ts:413-426](docs/.vitepress/config.ts)). The inline `@example` previews on the CSS-API pages
render in the **main document** (`.css-example > .instui-card`, not an iframe), so they inherit the
theme's own imports — and [theme/index.ts:12](docs/.vitepress/theme/index.ts) imports the pruned
`@pantoken/components/components.css`, which has no canvas overrides. So the main document never loads
the rule that repoints the hover border to link. (The `scope-components.ts` header comment already
*claims* "both the inline `@example` previews and the embedded `/play` demos load this one sheet" —
that intent was written but never wired for the inline previews.)

Mirror the established `site-themes.css` pattern for component **rules**: generate the scoped
multi-theme sheet into `theme/generated/`, import it in the theme, and copy it into `demos-assets/`
from there (instead of computing it inline for the iframes only).

In [demos.ts](docs/scripts/demos.ts), where it currently does

  `docs/.vitepress/theme/generated/components.css` (the canonical generated location — same dir as

import "@pantoken/components/components.css";

import "./generated/components.css";

## Root cause

Not staleness or caching — a **loading gap**. Your docs switch themes by toggling `<html data-pantoken-theme="…">`. Token *values* re-theme via `site-themes.css`, but component *rules* that repoint which token a property references (billboard's `-clickable:hover` border-color: text → link) get pruned out of the shipped `@pantoken/components/components.css` at build time. The inline `@example` previews render in the **main document**, and [theme/index.ts](docs/.vitepress/theme/index.ts) imported the pruned single-theme sheet — so the canvas override rule never loaded there.
